entity_raw.definition_raw:
You are able to spontaneously cast spells you have mastered more frequently than your peers.

Prerequisite(s): Collegiate arcanist spontaneous spell mastery class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional use of your spontaneous spell Mastery ability per day.

Special: You can take this feat multiple times.
